_fixture_note: Trimmed excerpt of a real architecture-phase .coresmith/interface_contracts.json.bak-chiplead. TWO contradictions of the ERS READ-serializer requirement are preserved verbatim: edge_event.representations.state_semantics[0].rule ('on sck_fall=1 it advances only the read serializer') and qspi_drive.rate_description ('updated by the engine only on synchronized SCK falling-edge events').
design_summary: Asynchronous quad mode-0 QSPI slave feeding a 64x64 triangle rasterizer behind the locked Caravel user_project_wrapper.

contracts.rate_description: At most one mutually exclusive one-cycle edge pulse per legal synchronized SCK transition; sampled_io is meaningful for host input only when sck_rise=1.

bootstrap_policy.rationale: The external host first establishes CS low and then supplies the SCK transitions that advance the transaction.

flow_control_policy.rationale: Edge pulses cannot be replayed or backpressured, so the engine always consumes each pulse in its asserted cycle.

enums.name: qspi_edge_event_code
enums.notes: Encoding is the concatenation {sck_rise,sck_fall}; 2'b11 is illegal and must never be generated.

state_semantics.name: nibble_sampling
state_semantics.rule: On sck_rise=1 the engine latches sampled_io as the current host nibble; on sck_fall=1 it advances only the read serializer. sampled_io changes without sck_rise have no host-input meaning.

contracts.notes: sck_rise=(~sck_prev)&sck_sync2 and sck_fall=sck_prev&(~sck_sync2); both pulses are derived and consumed only on wb_clk_i.

contracts.rate_description: Static drive controls updated by the engine only on synchronized SCK falling-edge events and held stable through the following rising-edge sample.

bootstrap_policy.rationale: Reset drives all output data low and disables the lanes, breaking the pin-level ownership loop without contention.

flow_control_policy.rationale: The wrapper continuously maps these levels to GPIO output and active-low output enable without backpressure.

state_semantics.name: lane_drive_window
state_semantics.rule: qspi_drive_en is 1 only for the post-dummy data phase of READ 0x03 or for exactly two response nibbles of READ_STATUS 0x05; otherwise it is 0, including reset, CS high, command, address, write data, and dummy turnaround.

contracts.notes: The wrapper maps qspi_io_out to io_out[5:2] and sets io_oeb[5:2]=4'b0000 iff qspi_drive_en=1, otherwise 4'b1111. Each byte is driven high nibble first and low nibble second.
